# llms.txt

## About Travel Tour Management System

A full-stack travel management platform that helps tour operators, hotel partners, and customers manage bookings, itineraries, payments, and reviews.

## Features

- Tour package creation and management
- Booking and payment processing
- Itinerary planning
- Customer management
- Hotel partner dashboard
- Admin panel with user, room, and report management
- Email notifications via Brevo SMTP
- PDF invoice generation with pdfkit

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, React Router, Lucide React
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), JWT auth
- **Payments**: Stripe-compatible flow with Brevo email integration
- **PDF**: pdfkit for invoice generation

## Repository Links

- Frontend: https://github.com/Giddala-Anjaiah/Travel_Tour_Management_System_front
- Backend: https://github.com/Giddala-Anjaiah/Travel_Tour_Management_System_Backend

## Crawl Guidance

- Allow: /, /login, /signup, /forgot-password
- Disallow: /admin/*, /customer/*, /tour-operator/*, /hotel-partner/* (authenticated routes)
- Disallow: /api/* (backend API)
